comments: Could not renew road tax at the counter because of outstanding summons. Officer explained I must settle the saman first. Queue was 50 minutes.
MyJPJ app shows my digital driving licence correctly. Very convenient at roadblocks.
My GDL was suspended for KEJARA points. I need to know how long the suspension lasts and how to appeal so I can keep driving the lorry for work.
Asked when my PDL converts to a full CDL. Call centre took 3 days to answer.
My licence expired in May and I was fined. I did not receive any reminder SMS from JPJ.
Paid summons through MyJPJ but payment failed twice with FPX. Money deducted once and refunded after 5 days.
Ownership transfer took two visits because the biometric verification machine was down.
Wanted to know if I can renew road tax online when insurance is still valid. Agent was helpful and fast.
Vehicle blacklisted because of old summons from 2023 that I never received. Requested a review of the blacklist.
Booking a counter appointment in MyJPJ is easy but slots in Klang are full for two weeks.
